steps.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: os, logging, json, psycopg2, RealDictCursor, dotenv, engine.base. _get_conn() EXACTLY as mandatory_patterns. Class IdeaBacklogManagerSkill with name='idea_backlog_manager', triggers=['backlog', 'idea backlog', 'pending ideas', 'triage ideas', 'manage ideas', 'idea pipeline', 'backlog status', 'what ideas are pending']. cache_ttl=300. Methods: async def execute, def _get_pending_count, def _get_backlog_status, def _get_stream_breakdown, def _build_summary. All 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _get_pending_count() and _get_backlog_status(). _get_pending_count: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM idea_inbox WHERE disposition = 'pending'. Return integer. _get_backlog_status: SELECT stream, priority, status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM idea_backlog GROUP BY stream, priority, status ORDER BY stream, priority. Return list of dicts. Both use _get_conn() with try/finally close. Use row['cnt'] not row[0].

Implement _get_stream_breakdown(). Use _get_conn(). Query: SELECT stream, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as done, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_progress, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'backlog' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as backlog FROM idea_backlog GROUP BY stream ORDER BY stream. Return list of dicts. try/finally close.

Implement _build_summary(self, pending, backlog_rows, stream_rows). Build: 'Idea Pipeline: N ideas pending triage.' If backlog_rows: 'Backlog: N items across M streams.' Per stream: 'STREAM: N total (X backlog, Y in progress, Z done)'. If no backlog items: 'Backlog is empty.' Return string.

Implement 'async def execute(self, request)'. Call all three query methods. Build summary. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'pending_count': pending, 'backlog': backlog_rows, 'streams': stream_rows}, summary=summary, confidence=0.95, sources=['mythos.idea_inbox', 'mythos.idea_backlog']). try/except/finally.
Review. _get_conn uses POSTGRES_HOST. execute is async def. UUIDs cast to str. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
